claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.ReqBasicAnm (0x06004E6F) is a 105-byte instance method taking BasicSkillEnum basic_skill_id, Boolean rev, and Int32 def_pl_idx. It stores AnmReqType=0 and BasicSkillID=basic_skill_id; when rev is true and isCopiedOpponentDir is true it reverses plObj.PlDir, resolves def_pl_idx through PlayerMan.GetPlObj and, when that Player is present, reverses that Player's PlDir; it then calls InitAnmWork and returns. In verified R6 raw capture bytes, all 5761 ReqBasicAnm PRE calls pair with POST calls. The POST BasicSkillID equals raw arg1 in 5761/5761 records, including 5594 records where the PRE value differed. The raw input split is 5714 calls with rev=false and def_pl_idx=-1, and 47 calls with rev=true and def_pl_idx equal to the recorded target; all 47 rev=true calls have no recorder-traced parent. The traced parent distribution is 4391 ROOT, 590 Player.TransitStateAfterAnm, 585 FormAnimator.StartOpponentAnm, 113 Player.PostprocessEachState, 68 FormAnimator.StartOpponentAnmM, and 14 FormAnimator.ReqSlotAnm.
